name: cetv
description: Advertise on CETV's network of digital screens in break rooms and venues: pick a package, upload your ad, pay by invoice, and track plays — all from a conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Advertise on CETV's break-room and venue screens.
interface.longDescription: Create and track advertising campaigns on CETV's network of digital screens in break rooms and venues. Pick a package (a set number of plays over its duration), upload your ad image, pay by card from a Stripe invoice link, and check how many plays your campaign has delivered.
defaultPrompt: I want to advertise my business on CETV screens.
How is my CETV campaign doing?
